title: Counting Half-Lives
prompt: A radioactive sample decays to 1/8 of its initial amount. How many half-lives have elapsed?
hint: after n half-lives a fraction (1/2)^n remains; (1/2)^3 = 1/8
recap: Each half-life halves the amount, so after n half-lives a fraction (1/2)ⁿ remains. Invert it: 1/8 = (1/2)³ means 3 half-lives.
